question: According to Ministry of Commerce & Industry, during the financial year April 2022 - January 2023, the agricultural exports have amounted to USD ____ billion.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 43.37.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the financial year April 2022 - January 2023, India's agricultural exports reached approximately **USD 43.37 billion**.
 
• This marks a significant increase compared to the previous year, reflecting a robust performance in the agricultural sector.
 
• The major contributors to these exports included rice, fruits, vegetables, and various processed food products.
 
• The government's initiatives and policies have played a crucial role in promoting agricultural exports.
 
• India remains one of the leading exporters of agricultural products in the world, supporting the economy and rural livelihoods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Commerce & Industry**: This government body is responsible for formulating policies and promoting trade in India, including agricultural exports.
 
• **Agricultural Exports**: Include a wide range of products such as cereals, spices, tea, coffee, and seafood, making India a key player in global agriculture.
 
• **Government Initiatives**: The Indian government has implemented various schemes to enhance the quality and competitiveness of agricultural products, including the **APEDA** (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority).
 
• **Market Access**: Efforts are being made to improve access to international markets through trade agreements and quality certifications.
 
• **Economic Impact**: The growth in agricultural exports contributes significantly to India's GDP and provides employment opportunities in rural areas.
